contract_grounding.note: No structured_contract.json found for this version. Analysis based on source code examination of validation logic.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: validateCanAddClass → setPropertyDefaults (line 714) → setPropertyDefaultTokenization (line 740) → sets Tokenization to 'word' when empty. Validation occurs BEFORE defaults are set, so empty string passes validation (line 1132: `if tokenization == "" { return nil }` for non-text types), but for text/text[] types the validation expects valid enum values (lines 1105-1129). Empty string is NOT in the allowed list but validation misses it because it falls through to line 1137 error which returns 'tokenization '' is not allowed'. However, the function at line 1132 incorrectly returns nil for empty string on non-text types, creating a bypass.
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: validatePropertyTokenization 函数在处理 text/text[] 类型时，switch 语句(行1105-1129)没有 case "" 处理，应该拒绝空字符串但实际会返回错误 'tokenization '' is not allowed'。然而，setPropertyDefaults 在验证之前被调用(行714)，将空字符串默认为 'word'，导致验证被绕过。这是一个参数验证漏洞：API 应该拒绝空字符串 tokenization，但却静默接受并默认为 'word'。

cognition_match.pattern_name: Parameter Validation Issues in Request Parsing
cognition_match.developer_quote: Parameter validation gaps at API boundaries
cognition_match.note: 候选命中 bug_shapes.json 的 BS-004 模式：request parsing 层的 parameter_validation 系统性缺陷。也命中 developer_cognition.json 的盲点指标 'Input validation is often incomplete at API boundaries'。维护者明确认为这类问题是 bug。

verdicts.rationale: 这是一个真实的参数验证漏洞。Weaviate 的 POST /schema 端点接受 text 属性的 tokenization 参数，当用户传递空字符串 "" 时，API 应该返回 4xx 错误拒绝无效输入。然而，源码显示 setPropertyDefaults 在验证之前静默将空字符串替换为默认值 'word'，导致 validatePropertyTokenization 被绕过。实验确认：发送 {"tokenization": ""} 的请求返回 HTTP 200，且存储的 schema 显示 tokenization='word'。这违反了参数验证的基本原则 - 应该明确拒绝无效值而非静默默认。此缺陷类型完全符合 Weaviate 维护者认可的 BS-004 (Parameter Validation Issues in Request Parsing) 模式。

contract.explicit_requirement: tokenization parameter must be a valid non-empty string from the allowed enum set (word, whitespace, lowercase, field, trigram, gse, gse_ch, kagome_kr, kagome_ja)

physical.objective_constraint: tokenization is an enum parameter with a fixed set of valid values; empty string is outside this set
